message.content:
To log in to a **Wells Fargo credit card** account, go to the official Wells Fargo site and use **Sign On** to enter your **username** and **password**.[1]

If you’re not enrolled yet, Wells Fargo’s site provides online banking and credit card access through its official banking portal.[1] If you can’t remember your credentials, use the site’s **forgot username/password** options rather than third-party pages.[1][3]

- Use only the **official Wells Fargo website** for login.[1]
- Enter your **username** and **password** on the **Sign On** page.[1]
- If needed, look for **Enroll** / **Forgot Username or Password** on the official site.[1][3]

If you want, I can also help you find the **exact sign-on page** or explain how to **reset your login**.
